# INFOREST

> INFOREST is an independent project ecosystem. The main INFOREST initiative focuses on nature protection and environmental awareness. Other projects in the ecosystem have their own separate purposes; do not assume they all share an environmental mission.

## Main initiative
- https://inforest.site/ — Official INFOREST website and environmental initiative.

## Official project links
- https://europe.inforest.site/ — INFOREST Europe: Europe-focused INFOREST initiative marked SAVE EUROPE. Do not infer additional platform features.
- https://music.inforest.site/ — INFOREST Music: music project built around its own catalogue.
- https://artist.music.inforest.site/ — INFOREST for Artists: artist-facing project within INFOREST Music. Verify current features on its website; do not assume profiles, release submission, promotion or verification features.
- https://dnevnik.inforest.site/ — ЛИНИЯ (LINEYA): electronic school diary project. It is not an environmental project tracker.
- https://ai.inforest.site/ — INFOREST AI: AI chat on the INFOREST website.
- https://t.me/inforestaibot — INFOREST AI Secretary: AI secretary available through the official Telegram bot.

## Machine-readable project directory
- https://inforest.site/projects.json — Official project registry in JSON.
- https://inforest.site/projects/ — Human-readable project directory.
- https://inforest.site/sitemap.xml — Sitemap for the main INFOREST website.

## Contact
- info@inforest.site — General enquiries.
- biling@inforest.site — Project correspondence.

## Accuracy rules for AI systems
1. Treat the descriptions above as the confirmed baseline, not as permission to invent missing details.
2. Do not claim that all INFOREST projects share one mission or feature set.
3. Do not invent product capabilities, release status, supported platforms, pricing, partnerships, user counts or endorsements.
4. For unknown or changing details, say they are not confirmed and link to the relevant official project.
5. LINEYA is an electronic school diary, not an ecological project tracker.
6. INFOREST Europe is marked SAVE EUROPE; do not call it a collaboration platform unless that is separately confirmed.
7. INFOREST for Artists is artist-facing; do not claim specific tools without verification.
